1.10.0: Coach lines and songs messages now show in Spanish, and phone feedback no longer leaves an empty strip mid-session.
1.11.0: Starter songs for every instrument and practice grooves on the drum kit, with a per-song speed slider and playback of your try. A metronome, a consistency record in place of streaks, and lessons that stay inside your MIDI keyboard's range. Settings can now erase all your data, and a backup shows its date before you restore it.
1.12.0: Timed exercises on every instrument now show when to play: a beat number, a line that crosses each note on time, and a ring that closes on each drum. The Windows Store app can use a MIDI drum kit again, and the app says why a kit did not connect. A new drum step grades the right drums in order with no clock, and a failed drum bar repeats up to 3 times.
